ligeance.definition:
n. The connection between sovereign and subject by which
   they were mutually bound, the former to protection and the securing of
   justice, the latter to faithful service; allegiance.
ligeance.translation: n. [律](臣民对君主的)忠诚,封地,领地

liger.definition: n. offspring of a male lion and a female tiger
liger.translation: n. (雄狮与雌虎的交配生)狮虎
